sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: the vision, knowledge and road examinations
Knowledge facts: part C holds 37 fact blocks (sec04-F01 onward) from physical pages 35 to 38; part C2 holds 17 confusable and continuation blocks (sec04-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the July 1, 2022 content date, the multiple-choice format and its four roughly equal topic areas, the vision standard and the one-day retake wait from physical pages 3, 35 and 36; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- TN-EXAM-A-EXAM — question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-EXAM-A-FRESH — content dated July 1, 2022; current edition and liveness unconfirmed (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-EXAM-D-LATE — late-arrival cutoff: more than five minutes versus five or more minutes (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-EXAM-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- TN-EXAM-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: appointment systems, phone numbers, the online proctored test program, the language list and the retest fee (for example sec04-F06, sec04-F12, sec04-F27, sec04-F37) can change and must be refreshed from the Department of Safety and Homeland Security website.

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.
